APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep the original control flow exactly (the skip-range advance, the bracket-depth tracking, the top-level `;`/declaration handling with the by-ref `k` jump, and the foreign-identifier filter). That brings `Uses` down to about 12, assuming the parameter types I couldn't check against the source (`List<(int From, int To)>`, `Dictionary<string, Foreign>`) match the originals.
